lines.en: label sanadorm20:
I knock on Sana's door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Sana 的门，等她来开门。

lines.en: I can hear her bed squeak as she hops off of it and scurries over to the door, footsteps sounding a bit more...urgent than normal.
lines.zh: 我听见床吱呀一响，她跳下床小跑到门边，脚步声听起来比平时……急切了几分。

lines.en: I doubt it's anything even close to excitement, but even the idea of her abandoning her conditioned hesitation is enough to remind me of our progress, and I'm not even inside yet.
lines.zh: 我不觉得这算得上什么兴奋，但光是她放下了惯有的犹豫这一点，就足以让我想起我们的进展——而我连门都还没进呢。

lines.en: : Sensei?...Is that you?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……是你吗？……

lines.en: : Sure is. Can I come in? Or are you going to try and use your pajamas as an excuse again?
lines.zh: : 是我。我能进去吗？还是说你又要拿睡衣当借口？

lines.en: : Hahah...no...you can come in...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……不……你进来吧……

lines.en: : I...um...unlocked the door for you...
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……给你把锁开了……

lines.en: scene black
See what I mean? Progress.
lines.zh: 懂我意思吧？进展。

lines.en: To be fair, if there wasn't any progress by now, I'd probably second guess all the effort I'm putting into hanging out with Sana-
lines.zh: 说句公道话，要是到今天还没有任何进展，我大概会开始怀疑自己为陪 Sana 付出的这些努力——

lines.en: But, at the same time, I doubt I'd give up on it simply because...
lines.zh: 但话说回来，我也不觉得自己会就这么放弃，仅仅因为……

lines.en: Well, you've seen her.
lines.zh: 嗯，你见过她的。

lines.en: scene weatherredux1
: How...
: How are you doing?...
lines.zh: : 你最近怎么样？……

lines.en: : Are you actually taking charge of the conversation today? Because normally, there's a little more stammering involved before you start asking me questions.
lines.zh: : 你今天居然主动开口了？平时你可是要结巴好一阵子，才会开始问我的。

lines.en: : Well, it's my room, so...I figured it would be...polite to ask...
lines.zh: : 嗯，这是我的房间嘛，所以……我觉得……礼貌起见该问一下……

lines.en: : Then, I'm fine. Thank you for asking. How are you doing?
lines.zh: : 那，我很好。谢谢关心。你呢？

lines.en: : I'm...also fine...
lines.zh: : 我……也很好……

lines.en: : Cool.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...
Progress.
lines.zh: 进展。

lines.en: : So, what were you doing before I showed up? Games again?
lines.zh: : 那么，我来之前你在干什么？又在打游戏？

lines.en: : Oh, no...I was just watching TV and...texting Ayane...
lines.zh: : 哦，没有……我刚刚只是在看电视，还有……给 Ayane 发消息……

lines.en: : Did you...did you know she has a room in her house that's...completely full of trampolines?...
lines.zh: : 你……你知道她家里有个房间……塞满了蹦床吗？……

lines.en: : No, but that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 不知道，不过这很符合她。

lines.en: : We can still watch TV if you want, Sana. You don't have to turn it off just because I'm here now.
lines.zh: : 你想看电视的话我们可以继续看，Sana。不用因为我来了就关掉。

lines.en: scene weatherredux2
: Well...actually...I'd rather talk to you if...that's okay...
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实……我更想跟你说说话，如果……可以的话……

lines.en: : But...but just because I...still need to practice...and stuff...
lines.zh: : 不过……不过只是因为我……还需要练习……之类的……

lines.en: : Hey, fine by me. Just promise not to freak out if we drift into a topic you're not ready for.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我没意见。只要你保证，万一聊到你还没准备好面对的话题，别崩溃就行。

lines.en: scene weatherredux3
: I don’t...freak out that often...do I?
lines.zh: : 我……我并没有那么经常崩溃吧……？

lines.en: : You kind of do. I know you're getting more comfortable around me but, in your current condition, I'm not sure if that skill will really translate to other conversations you might have.
lines.zh: : 其实还挺经常的。我知道你在我身边越来越自在了，但以你现在的状态，我不确定这种能力能不能真的迁移到你和别人的对话里去。

lines.en: scene weatherredux2
: That's okay...I'll just...only talk to you for the rest of my life...
lines.zh: : 那也没关系……我……这辈子只跟你说话就好了……

lines.en: : Sana, you're really going to have to get better with other people sooner or later.
lines.zh: : Sana，你迟早还是得学会跟别人好好相处。

lines.en: : But other people are...confusing...
lines.zh: : 可是别人……好难懂……

lines.en: : You’re...easy to understand...
lines.zh: : 你……很好懂……

lines.en: : That can't be true. There's no way you'd still open the door for me if you truly understood me.
lines.zh: : 这不可能。要是你真的懂我，你绝不会再给我开门的。

lines.en: scene weatherredux1
: Then...we really...should talk...
lines.zh: : 那……我们真的……该好好聊聊……

lines.en: : Were you not listening just now when I essentially told you that the more you know, the less you'll want to know?
lines.zh: : 我刚刚不是说了吗，你知道得越多，就越不想知道——你没在听吗？

lines.en: : I was...I just...don't believe you.
lines.zh: : 我听了……我只是……不相信你。

lines.en: : Well, that'll be your loss.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那是你的损失。

lines.en: : We can talk as much as you want. I just think it would be better if we strayed from anything involving my thoughts on you or anyone else you know.
lines.zh: : 你想聊多少都行。我只是觉得，最好还是别碰那些关于我对你的看法、或者对你认识的其他人的看法的话题。

lines.en: scene weatherredux4
: Do you...have thoughts about me you...need to keep to yourself?...
lines.zh: : 你……对我有什么……需要藏起来的想法吗？……

lines.en: : See, you're already crossing into dangerous territory. Ask me an easier question.
lines.zh: : 看吧，你已经踩进危险区域了。问个简单点的问题。

lines.en: : Oh. Um...uhh...
: Would you...would you like to sit down?...
lines.zh: : 你……你愿意坐下吗？……

lines.en: scene black
: Why, yes. Thank you, Sana. That is a much better start to this conversation than asking me the one thing I suggested you don't ask me about.
lines.zh: : 当然愿意。谢谢你，Sana。这比我建议你别问的那个问题，更适合当作这场对话的开场。

lines.en: : I'm...so confused...
lines.zh: : 我……好困惑……

lines.en: scene onthecouch1
As expected, the two of us sit awkwardly on the couch while Sana contemplates exactly what topics we can discuss without dismantling our relationship.
lines.zh: 不出所料，我们两个尴尬地坐在沙发上，而 Sana 正在苦思冥想，到底有哪些话题是我们能聊、又不会把关系聊崩的。

lines.en: But even though she appears determined, it’s times like these where I truly understand just how hard it is for her to converse with people.
lines.zh: 虽然她看上去很坚定，但正是这种时候，我才真正明白她和人交谈有多么艰难。

lines.en: Even though the two of us are only a few steps away from friends at this point, she’s still having a difficult time just making eye contact with me.
lines.zh: 尽管我们两个现在离朋友只剩几步之遥，她却连跟我对视都还是那么费劲。

lines.en: I wonder if this is how it is with her and Ayane as well?
lines.zh: 不知道她和 Ayane 在一起时是不是也这样？

lines.en: Granted, I’m sure Ayane is a lot better at making her feel comfortable than I am.
lines.zh: 当然，我相信 Ayane 比我更擅长让她放松。

lines.en: Which is a strange thing to think because Ayane also brings a sword to school sometimes and that's not really a thing I'd personally equate to comfort.
lines.zh: 这想法挺奇怪的，因为 Ayane 有时候还会带把刀来学校，而那东西我可不会跟安心联系在一起。

lines.en: Either way, Sana is doing her best. And it is my responsibility to not get in her way while she does that.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，Sana 已经在尽力了。而我的责任，就是别在她尽力的时候碍事。

lines.en: Eventually, she manages to break the silence.
lines.zh: 最终，她总算打破了沉默。

lines.en: scene onthecouch2
: Nice weather we’re having...
lines.zh: : 今天天气真不错……

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: Well, at least she tried.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少她努力了。

lines.en: : Sana, I'm going to let you in on a little tip.
lines.zh: : Sana，我给你透个底。

lines.en: : Avoiding that question is basically rule number one when it comes to holding a conversation.
lines.zh: : 聊天的第一原则，就是别问这种问题。

lines.en: : As soon as you ask someone about the weather, you’re essentially admitting defeat.
lines.zh: : 你一开口问天气，就等于举白旗认输了。

lines.en: scene onthecouch3
: I...I know that...I just...I don’t really know what else to say...
lines.zh: : 我……我知道……我只是……实在不知道还能说什么了……

lines.en: : I still feel strange...being alone in here with you...
lines.zh: : 和你单独待在这里……我还是觉得怪怪的……

lines.en: : It’s...a lot different than it is at the bar...
lines.zh: : 这和在酒吧的时候……很不一样……

lines.en: : You're right. It's a lot busier in here.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这里热闹多了。

lines.en: scene onthecouch4
: Very funny, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 真好笑，Sensei……

lines.en: : I get what you’re saying, though. This feels kind of weird for me too.
lines.zh: : 不过我懂你的意思。我也觉得有点怪。

lines.en: scene onthecouch5
: Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: Sana perks up when I tell her that. I guess just thinking that she isn’t alone in feeling lonely is enough to make her feel...less lonely?
lines.zh: 听我这么说，Sana 精神一振。我想，光是知道感到孤独的不止自己一个，就足以让她觉得……没那么孤独了吧？

lines.en: I lose track of what I'm thinking with how many times loneliness comes up.
lines.zh: 孤独这个词出现的次数太多，我都快忘了自己刚刚在想什么了。

lines.en: I'm glad she feels like she can relate, though.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴她觉得有人懂她。

lines.en: All I have to do is hide the fact that the majority of my discomfort stems from an unearthly desire to take her clothes off and everything will turn out a-okay.
lines.zh: 我只要把我的不自在多半来自想扒光她衣服的诡异冲动这件事藏好，一切就没问题了。

lines.en: : That's classified.
lines.zh: : 这是机密。

lines.en: : I can promise you that everything will be significantly less weird if we just ignore that I said that.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证，只要我们当没听见我刚才那句话，一切都会正常很多。

lines.en: scene onthecouch6
: Well...us being alone together is...already weird, so...yeah...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们两个单独待在一起……本来就挺怪的，所以……嗯……

lines.en: : Plus...I know you said it doesn't matter, but...I still feel weird about the...pajamas...
lines.zh: : 而且……我知道你说过没关系，可是……我还是对……睡衣这件事……觉得别扭……

lines.en: : Your pajamas are sweatpants and a giant hoodie. Why would that possibly make you feel weird?
lines.zh: : 你的睡衣就是运动裤加一件超大号连帽衫。这有什么好别扭的？

lines.en: : Because I...look like a...marshmallow that was held over the fire for too long...
lines.zh: : 因为我……看起来像……一颗在火上烤太久的棉花糖……

lines.en: : That’s the only way to eat marshmallows.
lines.zh: : 棉花糖就该烤成那样才好吃。

lines.en: scene onthecouch7
: You're not...
lines.zh: : 你不会是……

lines.en: : Thinking of eating me...are you?...
lines.zh: : 在想着要吃我吧……？……

lines.en: : I have come here today to devour you whole.
lines.zh: : 我今天来，就是为了把你整个吞下去。

lines.en: scene onthecouch8
: PLEASE BE GENTLE!
lines.zh: : 请……请温柔一点！

lines.en: : Sana, you know I'm kidding right?
lines.zh: : Sana，你知道我在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: scene onthecouch9
: But...you could if you really wanted to...so I need to...stay on guard...
lines.zh: : 可是……你真想的话是做得到的……所以我得……保持警惕……

lines.en: : Do you really trust me that little? I thought we were at a level where you didn't view me as a cannibal.
lines.zh: : 你就这么不信任我？我还以为我们已经到了你不会把我当食人魔的阶段了。

lines.en: : We were...until you said you wanted to eat me...
lines.zh: : 本来是的……直到你说想把我吃了……

lines.en: : That...was a joke...
lines.zh: : 那……是开玩笑的……

lines.en: scene onthecouch10
: I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : I was...playing along...
lines.zh: : 我刚刚……是在配合你……

lines.en: : But I guess I'm...not good at showing that, yet...
lines.zh: : 不过我大概……还不太会表现出来……

lines.en: : I know you’re not going to eat me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不会吃我的，Sensei。

lines.en: : I might be small...but I'd still be a lot of food. There’s no way you’d be able to finish me in...one sitting...
lines.zh: : 我虽然个子小……但分量应该还是挺足的。你不可能……一顿就把我吃完的……

lines.en: : That is why you don’t think I’d do it? Because you'd be too much to eat?
lines.zh: : 这就是你觉得我不会动手的理由？因为我太撑了？

lines.en: : That and how...I know you’re actually...a really nice guy...
lines.zh: : 还有……我知道你其实……是个很好的人……

lines.en: scene onthecouch11
: Umm...it’s kind of...embarrassing when you don’t say anything back...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你一句话都不回，还挺……让人难为情的……

lines.en: : It’s kind of embarrassing when you blindside me with compliments like that.
lines.zh: : 你冷不丁来这么一句夸奖，也挺让人难为情的。

lines.en: : You don’t seem very embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 你看起来一点都不难为情啊。

lines.en: : I don't seem very anything ever. It's kind of just who I am.
lines.zh: : 我看起来从来都不像有任何情绪。我大概就是这样的人。

lines.en: : Well...I'm embarrassed...so you can be too...if you want...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我在难为情……所以你也可以……如果你愿意的话……

lines.en: : You're embarrassed? How come?
lines.zh: : 你在难为情？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...that's...kind of a hard question to answer...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个……有点不好回答……

lines.en: : Could it be that you’re finally starting to see me as a little more than just a teacher?
lines.zh: : 会不会是你终于开始不把我只当成老师来看了？

lines.en: scene onthecouch12
: More than a...what?
lines.zh: : 不只是……什么？

lines.en: : Did you say...more than a teacher?...because...you are a teacher...so I will...obviously see you as that...
lines.zh: : 你说……不只是老师？……因为……你就是老师啊……所以我……当然会那样看你……

lines.en: scene onthecouch13
: Then it will mean absolutely nothing to you if I do this.
lines.zh: : 那要是我这么做，对你来说应该完全无所谓吧。

lines.en: : Do...what, exactly?...I don't know what you're...talking about...
lines.zh: : 做……做什么？……我不知道你在……说什么……

lines.en: : You will whenever you regain your senses.
lines.zh: : 等你回过神来就知道了。

lines.en: scene onthecouch14
: But...my senses are fine...
lines.zh: : 可是……我很清醒啊……

lines.en: : I guess I feel a little warm, but...other than that...
lines.zh: : 我是觉得有点热，不过……除此之外……

lines.en: : Other than that, I'm-
lines.zh: : 除此之外，我——

lines.en: : Sana. Look down.
lines.zh: : Sana。往下看。

lines.en: scene onthecouch15
: Why? What's-
lines.zh: : 为什么？什么——

lines.en: scene onthecouch16
: You really didn't feel that?
lines.zh: : 你真的什么都没感觉到？

lines.en: scene onthecouch17
: WHAT IS HAPPENING?! WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了？！你在干什么？！

lines.en: : Being hilarious.
lines.zh: : 在搞点好笑的。

lines.en: : ISN'T THIS...INAPPROPRIATE?!
lines.zh: : 这难道不……不合适吗？！

lines.en: : No. It's a test.
lines.zh: : 不。这是测试。

lines.en: : A TEST OF WHAT?! THIS IS NO TEST I HAVE EVER HEARD OF!
lines.zh: : 测试什么？！我从没听说过这种测试！

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I'm a teacher. I think I know a test when I see one.
lines.zh: : 你确定？我可是老师。什么样的测试我一眼就看得出来。

lines.en: scene onthecouch18
: THIS IS NOT A TEST! LEWD CONTENT MUST BE CENSORED!
lines.zh: : 这不是测试！猥亵内容必须被删除！

lines.en: : This isn’t even remotely lewd...
lines.zh: : 这根本算不上猥亵……

lines.en: : YES IT IS, SENSEI! THIS WOULD BE CENSORED IN A VIDEO GAME!
lines.zh: : 就是，Sensei！这种东西在游戏里是会被和谐的！

lines.en: : AND THEN PATREON WOULD TAKE IT DOWN ANYWAY BECAUSE EVEN IF A GAME HAS ZERO SEXUAL CONTENT BUT YOUNG LOOKING CHARACTERS LIKE ME EXIST INSIDE OF IT, THEY CAN DECIDE AT ANY GIVEN MOMENT THAT THEY DON'T WANT YOU TO EXIST ANYMORE!
lines.zh: : 而且就算游戏里一点色情内容都没有，只要里面存在像我这样看起来年纪小的角色，PATREON 照样可以在任何时候判定你不该继续存在！

lines.en: : 80%% OF YOUR INCOME COULD BE WIPED AWAY IN MINUTES AFTER WORKING WITH THEM FOR TWO STRAIGHT MONTHS AND EVEN RECEIVING THEIR APPROVAL!
lines.zh: : 你跟他们合作了整整两个月、甚至还拿到了他们的批准，结果 80%% 的收入可能在几分钟之内就被抹得一干二净！

lines.en: : THEN, WHEN THEY RANDOMLY DELETE THE PAGE THAT THEY REVIEWED THEMSELVES AND GAVE THE GREENLIGHT TO DESPITE NO CHANGES BEING MADE TO IT AT ALL, THEY WOULDN'T EVEN HAVE THE DIGNITY TO TELL YOU WHY THEY CHANGED THEIR MIND!
lines.zh: : 然后，他们随随便便就把那个他们自己审核过、明明一点改动都没有还给放行的页面删掉，甚至连告诉你改变主意的原因这点体面都没有！

lines.en: : TO THINK THAT A COMPANY WHO PRIDES THEMSELVES ON BEING A HOME FOR CREATORS COULD SIMPLY GHOST SOMEONE MAKING THEM THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS A MONTH WITHOUT EVEN TELLING THEM WHY SHOULD TERRIFY ALL CREATORS OUT THERE!
lines.zh: : 一家以创作者之家自居的公司，居然能对一个月替他们赚几千美元的人玩消失，连句理由都不给——光是想想就该让所有创作者胆寒！

lines.en: : WHAT IS THE POINT OF A TERMS AND CONDITIONS SYSTEM IF NO ONE AT THE COMPANY UNDERSTANDS IT?! DOES PATREON EVEN TRAIN THEIR EMPLOYEES?! WHO EVEN ARE THEIR EMPLOYEES?! WHO THE FUCK IS MORGAN?!
lines.zh: : 如果公司里没人看得懂，那这套条款系统还有什么意义？！PATREON 到底有没有培训过员工？！他们的员工到底是谁？！MORGAN 到底是他妈什么人？！

lines.en: : Sana, chill.
lines.zh: : Sana，冷静点。

lines.en: : FUCK YOU, MORGAN! FUCK YOU TO HELL!
lines.zh: : 去你的，MORGAN！你他妈下地狱去吧！

lines.en: scene onthecouch19
: You seem really passionate about all this.
lines.zh: : 你看起来对这事挺上心的。

lines.en: : Not as passionate as the people who are going to whine and bitch about this blatant breaching of the fourth wall.
lines.zh: : 还没那些会为这种明目张胆打破第四面墙而抱怨个没完的人上心呢。

lines.en: : I can hear it now...The older version was funnier...I liked it more when Sana looked really tall...
lines.zh: : 我已经能听见了……老版本更好笑……我还是更喜欢 Sana 看起来很高的时候……

lines.en: scene onthecouch18
: I'M STILL GROWING! LEAVE ME ALONE!
lines.zh: : 我还在长个儿呢！别烦我！

lines.en: : This is going to confuse so many new players.
lines.zh: : 这下可要搞晕不少新玩家了。

lines.en: : AAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!

lines.en: : Sana, I know you're going through some things right now, but I really think we should move on.
lines.zh: : Sana，我知道你现在正在经历一些事情，但我真的觉得我们该往前走了。

lines.en: scene onthecouch20
: Huh?...What?...
: Where am I?...
lines.zh: : 我在哪儿？……

lines.en: Did my hand really cause all of this?
lines.zh: 我的手真的引发了这一切？

lines.en: : I’m...feeling really tired all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我……突然觉得好困……

lines.en: : And my...throat suddenly hurts...
lines.zh: : 还有……嗓子突然好疼……

lines.en: : Why is...everything from the last few minutes...such a blur?...
lines.zh: : 为什么……刚才那几分钟的事……一片模糊？……

lines.en: : No clue. But I think it might be good if you maybe try and get some rest.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过我觉得，你也许该试着休息一下。

lines.en: : Rest?...But you just...got here...
lines.zh: : 休息？……可你才……刚来……

lines.en: : It would be...
lines.zh: : 那样的话……

lines.en: : Impolite for me to...
lines.zh: : 我太失礼了……

lines.en: scene onthecouch21
: Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: scene onthecouch22
Sana falls off of the couch and narrowly avoids hitting her head on the coffee table.
lines.zh: Sana 从沙发上摔了下去，险些撞到茶几上。

lines.en: I look down to make sure I don't see any blood, but I'm pretty sure she's going to be okay.
lines.zh: 我低头确认有没有流血，不过我敢肯定她不会有事。

lines.en: : Okay, well...I think it’s time for me to head out.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个……我觉得我该走了。

lines.en: : Do you need me to...carry you to the bed? Or can you handle yourself from here?
lines.zh: : 要我……抱你去床上吗？还是说你接下来自己能行？

lines.en: : S-Sensei?...Where are you going?...The bar doesn’t...close for...another hour...
lines.zh: : S……Sensei？……你要去哪儿？……酒吧还有……一个小时才……关门……

lines.en: : We’re not at the bar, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我们不在酒吧，Sana。

lines.en: : We’re not?...
lines.zh: : 我们不在吗？……

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不在。

lines.en: : Are we at school?...
lines.zh: : 那我们是在学校？……

lines.en: : Yup. Gym class is about to start. It's time to wake up.
lines.zh: : 对。体育课要开始了，该起床了。

lines.en: : Oh...okay...just...
: Five more minutes...
lines.zh: : 再睡五分钟……

lines.en: scene black
I think about, at the very least, propping Sana up against the couch-
lines.zh: 我琢磨着，至少把 Sana 扶起来靠在沙发上——

lines.en: But I realize that it’s probably in everyone’s best interest if I just...don’t do anything at all right now.
lines.zh: 但我意识到，对所有人来说最好的选择，大概就是我……现在什么都别做。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll ‘wake up’ in five more minutes and everything will be just fine.
lines.zh: 我相信再过五分钟她就会醒过来，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: And even though the night ended several steps short of tragedy, I got to hold a cute girl's hand...so everything was worth it.
lines.zh: 虽说这个夜晚离悲剧还差了好几步，但我牵到了可爱女孩的手……所以一切都值了。

lines.en: Even if it broke the fabric of reality for a few seconds.
lines.zh: 哪怕它让现实的经纬断裂了几秒钟。
